desc.en: Ziyarat’e Ameenullah is from the Ziyarat’e Jame’a (comprehensive pilgrimage prayer) so this can be recited in the shrines of all other infallible Imams (a) as it was recited by Imam’e Zamana (atfs) in the shrine of Kazmain (a) in the event of Late al-Haj Ali Baghdadi. This fact has been specified in some of the traditions of Imam Mohammad Baqir (a) and Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a) narrated by Jaabir consisting Ziyarat Ameenullah which is a proof of it being comprehensive (Jame’a).
desc.rurdu: Ziyarat’e Ameenullah, Ziyarat’e Jame’a mein se hai, lehaaza yeh ziyarat koi bhi Aimma (a) ke haram mein padhi ja sakti hai jaise keh Imam’e Zamana (atfs) ne Kazmain mein marhoom Al-Haj Ali Badhdadi ke waaqye mein padhi thi. Yeh haqeeqat Janabe Jaabir ke zariye Imam Muhammad Baqir (a) aur Imam Jafar Sadiq (a) ke ahadees mein bayaan kiya gaya hai jis se yeh saabit hota hai keh Ziyarat’e Ameenullah bhi Ziyarat’e Jame’a mein se hai.

desc.en: Late Mohaddis Qummi (r) says that this Ziyarat is known as “Ameenullah” is a reliable Ziyarat which has been mentioned in all the books of Mazaar (ziyaaraat) and Masaabeeh (lamps). Allamah Majlisi (r) said it is amongst the best Ziyarat due to its text and chain of narrators. One must recite it diligently at all the sacred places. It has been reported by authentically by Jaabir from Imam al-Baqir (a) that: When Imam Zainul Aabedin (a) recited the Ziyarat of the Commander of the Faithful (a), he stood at the grave and wept as he said…
desc.rurdu: Marhoom Mohaddis Qummi (r) farmate hai keh yeh ziyarat’e Ameenullah mohtabar sanad se hai jo tamaam Mazaar (ziyaaraat) aur Masaabeeh (lamps) ki kitaabo’n mein hai. Allamah Majlisi farmate hai keh iske alfaaz aur raawiyo’n ke lehaaz se yeh ek beh-tareen ziyarat hai. Is ziyarat ko tamaam Aimma (a) ke haram mein tawajjoh ke saath padhna chahiye. Yeh ziyarat Jaabir ne Imam Baqir (a) se riwaayat ki hai keh jab Imam Zainul Aabedin (a) ne Ameerul Momeneen (a) ki qabr’e mubarak ke saamne khade ho kar is ziyarat ko padhi aur girya karte huwe farmaya…

desc.en: Imam Muhammad Baqir (a) said: Indeed, anyone of our adherents (Shiah) who pronounces these words at the tomb of the Commander of the Faithful (a) or the tomb of one of the Imams (a) shall certainly have his prayer lifted up on a ladder of light, carrying the seal of the Holy Prophet (s)’s ring, and it shall be kept so until it will be delivered to the Riser from Muhammad’s Household (namely, Imam al-Mahdi (atfs)) who will receive the sayer of that prayer with good tidings, greetings, and honor.
